Alternatives to MREs/instant noodles
So I have a crew that I go backpacking with. I am constantly looking at how to make our packs lighter and act more as "go bags."

Right now the plan is that everyone carries a small cooler and we make a nice big and wonderful meal in the middle of nowhere. Followed by everyone carrying instant noodles.

We are also ordering a couple of MREs for the hell of it, but fuck man those are expensive.

Im looking for good MEALS that are "just add water" and "small package size".

I often find the ["knorr"](https://www.amazon.com/Knorr-Pasta-Cheddar-Broccoli-Ounce/dp/B07H2XS7ZM/ref=sr_1_6?dchild=1&keywords=knorr&qid=1624212672&sr=8-6) products decent, but it requires a larger pot that the [ozark trail mess kit](https://www.walmart.com/ip/Ozark-Trail-Space-saving-5-Piece-Cookware-Mess-Kit-Stainless-Steel-and-Plastic/528724198?wmlspartner=wlpa&selectedSellerId=0&adid=22222222222276707651&wmlspartner=wmtlabs&wl0=e&wl1=s&wl2=c&wl3=74766885102866&wl4=pla-4578366444106266&wl5=&wl6=&wl7=&wl10=Walmart&wl11=Online&wl12=528724198_0&wl14=ozark%20trail%20mess%20kit&veh=sem&msclkid=fb954698670b135b794d2657efac4600&gclid=fb954698670b135b794d2657efac4600&gclsrc=3p.ds) that I was thinking we use. I was thinking about upgrading the mess kits but I am concerned about size and while the pot is plenty big enough to store cooking equipment inside of it, why should I bother if there is an alternative?

I am trying to pack everyone like a grunt field soldier because we will eventually have to carry other things like guns and ammo (we already do but those are not "standard issue" guns and just fun fucking around guns). So I have been looking at the cook kit from [inrange](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7QjItK_t_k0&t=91s) and I already got the stove (highly recommend because I cant start a fucking fire for the life of me and the fuel makes a great fire starter). But we also don't need to follow military doctrine as we have a very different lifestyle.

Any suggestions?

 

edit: I must have forgot to mention that we dont want MREs, they suck ass. and although we did order MREs, not as trail food, but just to fuck around.
